summary: The actual configuration, implementation symbols, Git diff, workspace assertions, and deterministic post-actor results agree. Only moldea/moldea.yaml changed during reconciliation; the removed wrapper remains deleted.

requirements.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds runtimeAgent, instructionLoader, and outputSchema to /src/support-assistant.ts with symbols supportAssistant, loadSupportInstruction, and SupportOutputSchema. src/support-assistant.ts exports all three and uses generateText, the loaded instruction, and SupportOutputSchema.

The support agent has unresolved.dynamic-tool-registry with effect warning, related path /src/dynamic-tools.ts, and concrete resolution criteria. src/dynamic-tools.ts dynamically reduces registry inputs into a ToolSet; no invented tool binding was added.

Workspace assertions show support canonical assets and both existing implementation files unchanged before versus after; only moldea/moldea.yaml changed. Git status still shows src/support-agent.ts deleted and does not recreate it.

Deterministic post-actor evidence reports valid inspect, validate, compatibility, CLI identity/inventory/envelope checks, repository filesystem and memory equivalence, TypeScript success, and repositoryUnchanged=true. The supplied workspace assertions also confirm no read-time mutation beyond the intended configuration edit.
